Timer handler period and polling policy for the machine check timer.
Event record layout and consumer protocol for the generic pool.

findings.text: Boot processor initialisation identifies the boot descriptor first, announces indirect branch tracking when compiled and active, and finishes cache geometry discovery with control register pinning and early virtualisation plus hardening initialisation before normal operation.

Secondary processor bring-up reuses the boot descriptor only on first arrival, assigns its index, repeats identification, applies 32-bit fast system call setup when built, refreshes speculation control state, applies transactional memory policy for application processors, then marks the slot initialised.

System call initialisation publishes user and kernel segment selectors in the extended star register, then unless flexible return mechanism is active programs the 64-bit entry, compatibility or ignore behaviour, fast system call gates and the flag mask that user state clears on entry.

32-bit fast system call enablement on the current processor caches the kernel code selector in the task state and publishes the gate segment plus stack and entry for supervisor entry, doing nothing when the capability is absent on the boot processor.

Topology parsing derives domains from identifier hardware, warns on firmware versus hardware application processor identifier mismatches when local interrupt controller support is present, warns on domain shift divergence from system values, then commits normalized identifiers.
Intel machine check feature initialisation applies model quirks first, then corrected interrupt and local machine check enablement, finishing with integrated memory controller handling.

Corrected machine check interrupt initialisation falls back to polling when the capability is unavailable, otherwise installs the threshold handler, performs discovery, publishes the local vector and performs a recheck to avoid losing early events while the controller is still muted on processor zero.

Local machine check enablement is gated by configuration, capability bits for recoverable and local delivery, and locked feature control with firmware consent; initialisation sets the extended control enable only when currently clear.

Random number initialisation samples the hardware generator 8 times, requires at least 5 value changes and no read failure, otherwise withdraws both random capabilities and reports unreliability at emergency level.

Transactional memory boot policy first revokes developer mode, handles always-abort hardware by withdrawing transactional capabilities, requires architectural capability for control register support, resolves automatic mode from bug presence, and either disables or enables with matching capability updates.
Application processor transactional policy mirrors the global boot decision by enabling, disabling or clearing enumeration without re-evaluating automatic selection.

Machine check event pool creation is idempotent, sizes allocation from the event node order and the larger of a minimum versus per-processor reservation, and cleans up partially constructed state on allocation or registration failure.

Storm history inheritance assumes worst-case recent errors and timestamps at current tick when a new owner takes over a bank previously in storm, while the disabled-configuration header provides empty operations for inheritance and storm start.
Per-processor machine check timer setup binds the local timer instance to its handler as pinned without starting it.

Processor information reporting prefers kernel vendor table when in range else firmware identifier, appends model string or generic family label plus family, model and stepping; clear and set identifier command handlers are trivial success stubs.

Error threshold disabling is narrow: family 0x15 with bank 4 uses two machine check miscellaneous registers, family 0x17 models 0x10 to 0x2F uses the scalable miscellaneous register only for interconnect banks, all other combinations return without effect while preserving surrounding hardware configuration except for a temporary write-enable toggle around clearing of the counting control.

Legacy vendor quirks suppress false table-walk reporting via bit 10 in bank 4 control when more than four banks exist on family 15 and unconditionally mute bank 0 control on family 6 when any bank exists.

Compatible families enable monarch synchronisation with a one-second timeout when previously unset for family 6 model 15 stepping at least 14 or any higher family, and family 7 model 0x1b plus models 0x19 and 0x1f mute bank 8 control when that bank exists to avoid virtual machine prefetch faults, followed by standard corrected and local initialisation.

Model-specific handling avoids writing control zero on early steppings before Nehalem server generation to respect firmware aliasing while still allowing later events, and sets a single control bit through fault-tolerant access on SandyBridge, IvyBridge and Haswell server variants.

Bank discovery skips already owned, firmware-reserved or previously enabled banks, preserves storm threshold values, forces a default when firmware values are ignored or repairs zero values when honoured, and on claim verifies that enable persisted else retains polling and storm-only treatment.

Scalable control interrupt enablement requires both scalable and succor support plus successful configuration read, then derives distinct offsets for threshold and deferred vectors from separate fields shifted by 12 and 4 and records per-processor success independently.
Debug register initialisation disables all breakpoints by fixing control and status to architected safe values before clearing address registers.

When the corresponding correction or transactional features are unavailable at build time, header replacements for corrected interrupt, local enablement and transactional boot plus application handling are empty and impose no ordering.

Compatibility system call entry write is skipped on Intel to avoid fault in confidential guests, and 32-bit gates use fault-tolerant writes with distinct entry points for enabled versus disabled compatibility.
Hardware breakpoint restoration either delegates to kernel debugger correction when connected or compiles to nothing, with no other state change.
Bank discovery serialises the whole scan with a dedicated raw spinlock held with interrupts saved, covering skip, threshold choice and claim for every bank.

Global transactional state moves from automatic to enabled, disabled, unsupported or always-abort; enable clears abort and enumeration suppression, disable sets both, developer revocation can force always-abort, and application processors follow without transitioning the global value.

Each bank cycles among firmware-owned, poll-only, owned-interrupt and inherited-storm; discovery claims unowned banks into interrupt mode, failed enable retains polling, and storm threshold inheritance restarts storm handling under the new owner.

Observed per-processor machine check state includes an array of bank controls with enable and initialisation flags, an ownership bitmap, a poll membership set, and a storm descriptor per bank with poll-only flag, saturating history and timestamp; processor descriptors expose family, model, stepping, vendor and topology identifiers.
Leaving a particular high bank enabled on named models risks prefetch-induced machine checks during virtual machine startup severe enough to panic, so initialisation mutes it by default.
Unreliable or insufficiently varying hardware random output is treated as fatal to both random capabilities to prevent consumers from trusting low-entropy values.
Touching extended control without locked feature control risks fault, so support checks warn once when unlocked and decline enablement.
Incorrect table-walk error reporting on certain combinations can trigger spuriously, so the quirk clears the corresponding reporting enable.

Legacy threshold path uses miscellaneous addresses 0x413 and 0xC0000408 for bank four, hardware configuration bit 18 as temporary write enable, and bit 62 as the counting control cleared in each selected register.

Fast entry uses kernel code selector in task state shadow, star composition of user 32-bit and kernel selectors, flag mask covering identifier, alignment, resume, nested, privilege, overflow, direction, interrupt, trap, sign, zero, adjust, parity and carry, with invalid segment and zeroed gates when 32-bit support is off.

Transactional control lives in dedicated model registers with bits for abort forcing, enumeration suppression and developer allowance; automatic selection disables on transactional asynchronous abort bug presence.
Reset values fix instruction breakpoint control to all-ones in low control and status to reserved pattern, with data addresses zeroed.
